curb_weight_kg.notes: Relay of Toyota Canada figure for the XLE FWD (57.7 kWh, matches our variant): 1,840 kg (4,057 lb) listed as Weight. Matches US 4,057 lb for XLE FWD.
Canadian XLE AWD: 2,025 kg (4,464 lb) listed as Weight. A dealer spec site lists 4,376 lb for all AWD trims (US-style figure); a Toyota Canada summary excerpt also read about 2,025 kg.

Converted from 4,464 lb (x0.45359 = 2,024.8): Canadian dealer page relaying Toyota Canada, Limited AWD. Fact-check: a search excerpt of the Toyota Canada sheet also shows 2024.84 (4464). The Car Guide page gives 2,065 kg (4,553 lb) and is treated as the outlier.
Canadian SE FWD: 1,900 kg (4,189 lb) listed as Weight (matches Toyota Canada summary excerpt 1900 (4188.8)). US lists only AWD (SE 4,322 lb).

Canadian XSE AWD: 2,000 kg (4,409 lb) listed as Weight; applied to both 18- and 20-inch trims as the source gives one XSE AWD figure. US AWD SE 4,322 lb / XSE 4,366 lb differ. The cited page is the XSE AWD (20-inch) trim; the 18-inch SE AWD weight was not checked (US data suggests about 1 % lighter).

Converted from 4,453 lb (x0.45359 = 2,019.8): Canadian dealer page base curb weight for the base AWD trim (338 hp). Luxury AWD 4,542 lb and Technology AWD 4,486 lb are heavier; US Premium AWD is 4,395 lb.
Converted from 4,187 lb (US S+ FWD; same 75 kWh pack and 214 hp as Canadian S+): 4,187 x 0.45359 = 1,899. EV Specifications lists 1,908 kg for S+ (column mapping unverified).
Converted from 4,231 lb (US SV+ FWD): 4,231 x 0.45359 = 1,919. Matches EV Specifications 1,919 kg. Guide Auto gives a Canadian lineup range of 1,802-1,991 kg.

EV Specifications: about 4,369.56 lb (1,982 kg); cars.com and iSeeCars show 4,369 lb for US Platinum+ (x0.45359 = 1,982). EV Specifications does not state its source; the cars.com/iSeeCars figures were not opened by the fact-checker.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 70 mph (112.7 km/h) steady, ~3.3 °C (38 °F) avg, dry not stated, 19-inch alloy wheels, battery-side vs wall-side not stated by the article (Out of Spec normally reads the car display) | Out of Spec Reviews test of a 2026 Platinum+ (75 kWh, 214 hp, same as ours), reported by InsideEVs: 215 mi at constant 70 mph until power was limited, averaged 2.8 mi/kWh. Conversion: 1000 / (2.8 x 1.609344) = 221.9 Wh/km. Cold ambient, so higher than a mild-weather figure. Other tests seen, not recorded: MotorTrend 70 mph 243 mi; Consumer Reports SV+ 292 mi at 70 mph. | NOT FOR CALIBRATION: cold test (about 3 °C); exclude from the highway-factor fit (item 3.7).
